svg.title: Two ways in: the global tier and the chained frontend
svg.desc: On port 80, lb-global sends you to a regional frontend, fe-uks on lb-uks or fe-ukw on lb-ukw, which forward to vm-web1 or vm-web2; fe-uks is not chained, because Gateway Load Balancer does not work with the global tier. On ports 8081 to 8090, lb-uks's second frontend fe-uks-chained uses its inbound NAT rule to reach port 8080 on vm-web1, and being chained to lb-gw, its traffic first passes through vm-nva over two VXLAN tunnels.
